topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing, outlining the lecture structure and key learning outcomes regarding cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Clonal selection and epigenetic alterations in cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer develops through the evolutionary selection of genetically and epigenetically altered cell clones.

topics.label: Stem cell hierarchies and the cellular origin of tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how stemness, cellular hierarchy, and specific cells of origin influence the initiation and propagation of cancer.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory drivers of cancer progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how external promotional signals, chronic inflammation, and supportive stroma permit and sustain tumor growth.

topics.label: Experimental and computational methods for studying tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the experimental technologies and computational approaches used to investigate clonal dynamics and spatial organization in tumors.

topics.label: Integrated multi-factorial model of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesises how mutational, epigenetic, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental factors interact to drive the evolutionary development of malignancy.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the closing framing, concluding the lecture and previewing the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
